transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?
I've been feeling really down and depressed almost every day, and it's just not getting any better. This constant sadness has been going on for about a year and nine months now.
Have you had any period of at least two months during this time when your mood felt back to normal, or has it been present כמעט every day without a long break?
No, I haven't had any breaks like that at all. It has been there almost every single day without any relief for the entire time.
